title: Monthly Water Bill Estimate
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume / Flo / HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watermeter:flow
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(volume_l) as litres by _time
| eval kilolitres=round(litres/1000,2), est_bill=round(kilolitres*rate_per_kl,2)
| sort - _time
description: Turns your metered water use into a running monthly cost estimate so the bill never comes as a shock.
value: Water bills arrive quarterly and vaguely; a monthly running estimate keeps usage and cost connected while you can still change habits.
implementation: Ingest metered volume and your tariff; schedule monthly and trend the estimated cost.
visualization: Column chart of estimated monthly water cost.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how much water you use into an estimated monthly cost, so the bill is never a surprise.
